description: Save an analytics report for reuse. Give it a NAME plus the same measure / group_by (/ dimension_key / agreement_id) you'd pass to `analyze` — the governed spec is stored under that name (re-saving the same name updates it). Later, `run_report` re-runs it on current data. Requires a connected Aurgus account.

name.description: A name to save this report under (e.g. 'Rebate by class').

name: save_report
